'''J'Kek M'hoy Trinia''' was the leader of a faction of [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophers]] on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. During the [[Corellian/Aqualish war]], J'Kek M'hoy Trinia was critical of then-[[Rel'Kan]], [[J'Kek D'rith Kalama]] and his policy of playing the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] and [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] were too risky and demanded he withdraw all concessions.
